title: Medical Coder
summary: Medical coders read US patient charts and turn diagnoses and procedures into standard codes (ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS) that insurers use to pay hospitals and doctors. They work in coding teams at Indian healthcare outsourcing firms, with team leads and quality auditors checking their work.
dailyDuties: Review patient charts and assign ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes
Assign CPT and HCPCS codes for procedures and services
Apply modifiers and check NCCI edits before sign-off
Use the encoder tool to confirm code choices
Fix codes flagged in quality audit feedback
Meet daily chart productivity and accuracy targets
Raise documentation queries with the team lead

skills.expectation: Assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes from US patient charts
Assign CPT and HCPCS Level II codes for procedures, services and supplies
Code in at least one specialty such as E/M, ED or surgery profee
Code in at least one specialty such as inpatient ICD-10-PCS with DRG
Code in at least one specialty such as HCC risk adjustment
Read physician notes using anatomy, physiology and medical terms
Apply official guidelines, NCCI edits and modifiers correctly
Take part in coding quality audits and fix audit feedback
Handle patient health information under HIPAA rules
Meet daily chart productivity and accuracy targets, often 95% or more
Use an encoder such as 3M or EncoderPro to check codes
Know how Medicare and commercial payer rules affect coding
Review coding-related denials and correct codes
Track productivity and audit results in spreadsheets
